scenes.narration: Who moves money while chatbots write poetry?
SAP’s October announcement has plenty of AI buzz. But look at the transactional plumbing underneath.
SAP Pay embeds payments into Cloud ERP. It's generally available in the US and UK. Less copy-paste, more cash flow.
And financial consolidation accepts SAP and non-SAP data. Because let's face it: nobody’s architecture is totally spotless.
For that consolidation product, Early Adopter Care is planned for Q1 2027. That's a roadmap date, not general availability.
My takeaway? Check the plumbing and the rollout dates before you buy the demo’s fireworks.
Which awkward system would your balance sheet need to invite? Read the announcement below.

publication.text:
Everyone notices the AI fireworks. I’m watching the finance plumbing.

Three distinct details from SAP’s October 12 announcement:

• SAP Pay embeds payment execution in SAP Cloud ERP. It is generally available in the United States and United Kingdom.

• SAP Enterprise Financial Consolidation is built on SAP Business Data Cloud and supports data from SAP and non-SAP systems. Mixed landscapes are part of the story.

• Early Adopter Care for that consolidation product is planned for Q1 2027. That date is not a general-availability promise for every finance feature.

My take: check the product, the geography, and the rollout status before planning around a headline.
